annotations.title: chainpeek: an account's transaction count (nonce) on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Get an account's transaction count on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For the next nonce with balance and gas checks use transfer_preflight; for the chain head use get_block_number. Returns the account's transaction count (`nonce`, and `nonce_hex`) at `latest`, `pending` (includes the node's mempool: the next nonce to send) or `finalized`, from eth_getTransactionCount. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only; read-only: nothing is signed or sent. RPC reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad address, hash, hex string, block or range is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html

block.description: latest (default), pending (counts the node's mempool: use it for the next nonce to send) or finalized.
